label: Sonoff Zigbee Bridge Pro (ZBBridge-P)
description: Sonoff Zigbee Bridge Pro (ZBBridge-P) is a Zigbee 3.0 coordinator that pairs up to 128 Sonoff/eWeLink Zigbee sub-devices and runs local smart scenes and alarms for them. It is WiFi-only on the network side: 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n powered from a 5 V USB supply, with no Ethernet port - the Zigbee 3.0 radio faces the sensors and is not modelled as an IP interface.
